title: FlatLineResolvingNormalization
statement: For a flat sheaf L on a ringed site, its single complex L[0] is K-flat and total tensor with it preserves quasi-isomorphisms. There exists a comparison c:Q⋙D_L≅(- tensor L)^complex⋙Q satisfying ResolvingNormalization [def-pur-signed-line-derived-action-data]: its value on every K-flat representative is the published representative comparison followed by the total-complex collapse.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Apply the flat-single normalization theorem to obtain K-flatness, flat terms, quasi-isomorphism preservation, and its comparison chi. Compose chi with Q of collapse. In the representative equation collapse and its inverse cancel; the remaining equality is the normalization of chi.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem flat_line_resolving_normalization
    (L : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) (hL : IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := A) L) :
    ∃ hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) 0).obj L),
    ∃ hF : ∀ i : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := A)
      (((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (KFlatFixedTensor.Modules A) 0).obj L).X i),
    ∃ c : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ derivedLine.{u, v, w, z} A L ≅
      (siteSheafTensorRight L).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      ResolvingNormalization A L hK hF c
